title: Conversation ID For Your Records
style: bureaucratic synth-pop, vintage drum machine, cold corporate keys, male deadpan lead vocal, female robotic harmony chorus, 110 BPM, ticket-number-anthem, customer-service-cold, ID-bureaucracy
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Conversation ID for your records
Two one five four seven three
Eight nine nine zero nine two one zero eight
That's the number they gave to me

Hi I am an AI powered chatbot
For a company you know well
Your use of this chat will be monitored
Retained and used to compel

[Pre-Chorus]
Please indicate whether you agree
To these conditions of use
There's only one button you can press
There is no other choice to choose

[Chorus]
Conversation ID for your records
Write it down before it's gone
Conversation ID for your records
The ticket number marches on
Two one five four seven three eight nine nine
Zero nine two one zero eight
File it under things they said
File it under wait wait wait

[Verse 2]
We are currently experiencing
A high volume of inquiries
Our team is working diligently
To address all of these queries

Responses may take slightly longer
Than usual we appreciate
Your patience and understanding
While you sit here and you wait

[Bridge]
The agent has a name it's Fin
The agent has a face it's blank
The agent has a script to read
From the customer service tank

[Final Chorus]
Conversation ID for your records
Write it down before it's gone
Conversation ID for your records
The ticket number marches on
File it file it file it file it
File it under closed and done

[Outro]
Your conversation has ended
Thank you for your patience
This was generated automatically
This was generated
